captions.detailed: A compact benchtop laboratory monocular microscope featuring a heavy rectangular base, a swept support arm, a monocular head, and a rectangular specimen stage in black. The stage is equipped with slide clips and a coaxial stage-axis control knob assembly on its side. The optical body carriage slides vertically on the column, the objective turret rotates continuously around its central axis, and the stage carriage slides horizontally from left to right.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a compact laboratory monocular microscope. Ensure it has a heavy rectangular base, a vertical support column, a movable optical body carriage with a rotating objective turret, and a separate black specimen stage with a side-mounted coaxial control knob that rotates on its local axis.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a rounded Box primitive. Build the main column and swept arm with combined Box extrusions. Model the stage using a thin black Box, adding small rectangular clips on top. Create the optical body using a tilted Cylinder for the monocular tube and a revolving turret with small cylindrical objectives. Define prismatic joints for the vertical optical carriage and horizontal stage movements, and continuous revolute joints for the objective turret and the coaxial stage control knobs.
